messages.subject: Cross-lagged panel model vs. Mplus: specification error?
parts:
I have struggled for some time to recreate this Mplus model in lavaan and come very close, though there are still minor differences in a few parameter estimates (for more info about the model, see http://doi.org/10.1037/a0038889). Naturally I wonder if anyone of out there familiar with both Mplus and lavaan is able to find a minor deviation. Note that variable numbering is 0-12 in the lavaan data and 1-13 in Mplus:

DEFINE:

Oi BY OUTCOME1-OUTCOME13@1;[EA2]

[Oi];[EA4]

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Cross-lagged panel model vs. Mplus: specification error?
parts: able to find a minor deviation

I think Mplus provides model matrices indicating the free/fixed parameters in the TECH1 output by default.  You can compare this to the lavaan output to see how your models differ:

lavInspect(fit, "free")

parts: Thanks, this was of much help and I have now found a way to replicate the Mplus syntax precisely. If anyone who comes across this thread is interested in the solution, it was necessary to specify the means for the latent variables p and q already as these variables were define in order to properly constrain the model.

parts: I also wish to briefly note that for some reason it appears to be necessary to specify for example "p2 ~ alpha1*p1..." rather than "p2 ~ alpha*p1...", and to impose constraints later ("alpha2 == alpha1" and so on).
